evidence: The film thickness of ZrO2 on a Si substrate is in a single linear relation with the number of deposition cycles even in different ZTB vapor pressures ranging from 0.01 kPa to 0.04 kPa. The film thickness was measured by ellipsometry, assuming the ZrO2 refractive index was 2.05. The surface roughness (Ra) at a Tsub of 200 °C is the smallest. The average surface roughness (Ra) was 1.031022 nm in ~b!.
